offering_description.value: Sells vacation ownership interests in resort condominiums to individual consumers, finances those purchases, and manages the resorts and points-based club membership programs.

primary_products.value: vacation ownership interests; points-based club memberships; resort condominium inventory

primary_services.value: resort management; consumer financing; rental and exchange services; property management

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers and families buying vacation ownership interests and club memberships

end_markets.value: leisure travel; hospitality; residential real estate

revenue_model.value: product sales: vacation ownership interests sold to consumers; interest or premiums: interest earned on consumer financing notes; service fees: annual club dues and resort maintenance fees; commissions or management fees: management fees for resorts run for owners' associations
revenue_model.category: product sales; interest or premiums; service fees; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs resort inventory and club properties, takes in owner dues and fees; service provider: manages third-party resorts and rental operations, sells to owners and guests; financial intermediary: finances consumer purchases of vacation ownership, takes in loan payments from buyers
value_chain_position.category: asset operator; service provider; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: global: resorts in US, Caribbean, Mexico, Canada, Europe, Asia and Australia

specialization.value: related lines: vacation ownership sales, consumer financing, resort management and exchange services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales staff selling to guests and prospects at resort sales centers and tours; own locations: sales centers and resorts operated by the company; online: online marketing and reservations for owners and guests

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: timeshare sales and consumer lending rules from US states and federal consumer finance regulators, plus foreign resort and sales laws

notes: Resort brands, locations and service lines may have changed since my knowledge was last updated.
